title: unified-rollouts: add quarantine probing stage and automated rollback workflow
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add a quarantined probing stage to the unified rollouts system to allow transient / noisy regressions to be isolated before triggering full rollback. This PR implements an automated quarantine/rollback workflow used by canary, A/B and shadow rollouts.

Scope: controller changes, autorollback engine extension, new metrics + telemetry, e2e tests for staged quarantine behavior, and docs for rollout policy configuration.

Design summary: The rollout FSM gains an additional 'quarantine' probing state that runs when a metric quorum detects a potential regression but the anomaly signal is weak or noisy. Quarantine opens a short probing window where traffic is diverted to a probing replica set and additional metrics (quorum votes, error provenance, latency histograms) are collected. If quarantine confirms regression above thresholds the autorollback executes; otherwise the rollout continues and quarantine findings are attached to trace events for postmortem.

Checklist:
- [x] Controller: add quarantine state transitions and guard rails
- [x] Autorollback engine: support quarantine-decisions and manual override
- [x] Observability: emit quarantine_start/quarantine_end and quorum metrics
- [x] E2E tests: staged canary + quarantine scenario tests
- [x] Docs: rollout policy options and examples
- [x] Performance: microbenchmark to ensure controller added latency < 2ms per decision

Rollback policy notes: New policy fields: quarantine_window (secs), quarantine_quorum (percentage), quarantine_metrics (list), quarantine_auto_rollback (bool). Default disables quarantine to preserve current behavior.

Compatibility: Backwards compatible - controllers without policy set will ignore quarantine fields. Migration notes included in docs.

Related: closes ENG-2345, references ENG-2401 for follow-up alerting work.

release_notes:
- Added 'quarantine' probing stage to unified rollouts.
- New rollout policy fields: quarantine_window, quarantine_quorum, quarantine_metrics, quarantine_auto_rollback.
- Quarantine disabled by default to maintain existing behavior.
- New telemetry: quarantine_start/quarantine_end and quarantine_quorum_vote metrics.
testing_notes: E2E: quarantine_canary_test covers: 1) noisy variance leading to quarantine and continue, 2) confirmed regression leading to auto-rollback, 3) missing quorum sources -> conservative rollback. Local bench measured decision latency increase < 2ms under typical load. Observability validated: dashboard shows quarantine events and histogram distributions.
rationale: Quarantine provides a middle-ground between immediate rollback and noisy false positives; it reduces user-visible churn while preserving safety via an auto-rollback path when regressions are confirmed.
